sloka: ततः शरौघैरभिवर्ष्यमाणो विभिन्नगात्रः कपिसैन्यपालः।नीलो बभूवाथ निसृष्टगात्रो विष्टम्भितस्तेन महाबलेन ।। ६.७०.३० ।।
transliteration: tataḥ śaraughairabhivarṣyamāṇo vibhinnagātraḥ kapisainyapālaḥ।nīlo babhūvātha nisṛṣṭagātro viṣṭambhitastena mahābalena ।। 6.70.30 ।।

translations.english: Neela's body wetted by arrows all over, the limbs pierced with arrows, the monkey leader remained powerless and could not move in spite of being extraordinarily strong.
